     def _pillow_char_is_emojiish(ch: str, next_ch: str = "") -> bool:\n            if not ch: return False\n            # U+26E4 is the same monochrome pentagram used by the console\n            # renderer.  It is in the broad dingbat range, but routing it to\n            # Segoe UI Emoji changes its metrics and can turn the outline into\n            # a colored/missing glyph in the floating bitmap.\n            if ch == "⛤":\n                return True\n            # Emojimaxx circled numbers are deliberate text symbols, not pictorial\n            # emoji.  Segoe UI Emoji renders U+2776 as a huge purple keycap-like\n            # disc, which destroys the fitted karaoke line and makes ❶ look like\n            # an unrelated icon. Keep the whole circled-number family in the\n            # primary lyric font.\n            if ch in CIRCLED_NUMBER_GLYPHS:\n                return False\n            cp=ord(ch); nxt=ord(next_ch) if next_ch else -1\n            return bool(0x1F000<=cp<=0x1FAFF or 0x1FC00<=cp<=0x1FFFF or 0x2600<=cp<=0x27FF or 0x2190<=cp<=0x21FF or 0x2300<=cp<=0x23FF or 0x2B00<=cp<=0x2BFF or 0x1F1E6<=cp<=0x1F1FF or 0x1F3FB<=cp<=0x1F3FF or cp in {0x00A9,0x00AE,0x2122,0x200D,0x20E3,0xFE0E,0xFE0F} or nxt in {0x20E3,0xFE0F})\n\n\n        @lru_cache(maxsize=8)\n        def _pillow_font_codepoints(path: str) -> return frozenset()\n\n        @lru_cache(maxsize=256)\n        def _pillow_symbol_font(pixel_size: int):\n            from PIL import ImageFont  # type: ignore\n            path = preserving joined emoji clusters."""\n            for run, is_emoji in _pillow_mixed_font_runs(text):\n                if not is_emoji:\n                    yield run, False\n                    continue\n                preferred = emoji_font if emoji_font is not None else primary_font\n                coverage = _pillow_font_codepoints(str(getattr(preferred, "path", "")))\n is_emoji: bool) -> float:\n            """Return the visible horizontal advance for one mixed-font run.\n\n            Segoe UI Emoji\'s nominal advance can contain a conspicuous right-side\n            bearing.  When a colored emoji is followed by an ordinary source space,\n            that bearing plus the real space looks like two or three spaces.  Emoji\n            runs therefore advance to their *ink* right edge; ordinary text keeps\n            normal shaping/textlength semantics.  ``textbbox`` alone is not enough:\n            on some Windows color-font builds it still reports the glyph cell\'s\n            transparent right padding rather than its painted pixels.\n            """\n            kwargs={} if is_emoji else _pillow_cursive_shaping_kwargs()\n            if is_emoji:\n                # FreeType\'s rendered grayscale mask gives us the true ink bounds\n                # without depending on whether Pillow can composite this color\n                # emoji in the L-mode lyric mask. ink_box = glyph_mask.getbbox()\n                    if ink_box is not None and int(ink_box[2]) > 0:\n                        return float(ink_box[2])\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n                try:\n                    box=draw.textbbox((0,0),run,font=font,anchor="ls")\n                    right=float(box[2])\n                    if math.isfinite(right) and right>0:\n                        return right\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n            try:\n                return max(0.0,float(draw.textlength(run,font=font,**kwargs)))\n            except Exception:\n                box=draw.textbbox((0,0),run,font=font,**kwargs)\n                return max(0.0,float(box[2]-box[0]))\n\n\n        def _pillow_mixed_text_width(draw, text: str, primary_font, emoji_font) -> float:\n            total=0.0\n            for run,is_emoji in _pillow_run_advance(draw,run,font,is_emoji=bool(is_emoji))\n            return total\n\n\n        def _pillow_font_metrics(font) -> tuple[int, int]:\n            """Return ascent/descent for         scratch = Image.new("L", (8, 8), 0)\n            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(scratch)\n            words = lyric.split()\n\n            def candidate(pixel_size: int):\n                font = current = word\n                    else:\n                        current = proposed\n                if current:\n                    lines.append(current)\n                if not lines:\n  return None\n                return font, emoji_font, lines, widths, line_height, shadow, padding\n\n            # V372: a 4K window can produce a 300+ px desired font.  Walking\n            # every size downward repeatedly opened/measured fonts and was the\n            # largest cue-change spike.  Search for the largest fitting size in\n            # O(log N) candidates instead.\n            low, high = 10, desired_pixels\n            chosen = None\n            while low <= high:\n                mid = (low + high) // 2\n                attempt = candidate(mid)\n                if attempt is not None:\n                    chosen = attempt\n                    low = mid + 1\n                else:\n                    high = mid - composite_karaoke_over_visualizer(\n                    styled_text: str,\n                    *,\n                    physical_row: int,\n                    start_column: int,\n _pillow_fit_canvas_image(data: bytes, width: int, height: int):\n            """Decode and contain one artwork blob in an exact transparent RGBA frame.\n\n            Crossfading sources of different shapes still requires identical frame\n            dimensions, but unused aspect-ratio gutters are alpha=0 so the popup\'s\n            chroma-key background shows the desktop rather than black letterboxing.\n            """\n            from PIL import Image, ImageOps  # type: ignore\n            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(data))) as opened:\n                source = opened.convert("RGBA").copy()\n            fitted = ImageOps.contain(\n                source,\n                (max(1, width), max(1, height)),\n                method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS,\n            )\n            canvas_image = Image.new("RGBA", (max(1, width), max(1, height)), (0, 0, 0, 0))\n            canvas_image.alpha_composite(\n                fitted,\n                ((canvas_image.width - fitted.width) // 2, (canvas_image.height - fitted.height) // 2),\n            )\n            return canvas_image, source\n\n        def _cancel_crossfade(*, commit_target: bool """Cheap per-glyph approximation of Pillow Color+Brightness transforms."""\n            red, green, blue = (float(value) for value in rgb)\n            gray = 0.299 * red + 0.587 * green + 0.114 * blue\n            sat = max(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MIN, min(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MAX, float(saturation)))\n            bright = max(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MIN, min(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MAX, float(brightness)))\n            values = (\n                (gray + (red - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (green - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (blue - gray) * sat) * bright,\n            )\n            return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(round(value)))) for value in values)  # type: ignore[return-value]\n\n        def _artwork_native_fast_path_allowed(\n            width: int, height: composite_karaoke_over_visualizer(\n                    styled_text: str,\n                    *,\n                    physical_row: int,\n                    start_column: int,\n                    cell_multiplier: int,\n                    sample_background: bool,\n                ) -> str:\n                    """Paint karaoke glyphs without erasing spectrum in whitespace.\n\n Spaces between\n                      words are *not* karaoke glyphs, so cursor motion skips across\n                      them instead of printing spaces that would erase the spectrum.\n                    - Mode 2 ("under") uses the same glyph-aware mask, but samples\n                      the exact spectrum RGB hidden by each non-space glyph and\n                      applies that RGB as the glyph\'s terminal background.\n\n                    This is intentionally character-aware. A terminal cannot display\n                    a DRCS spectrum glyph and a lyric glyph simultaneously in one\n                    cell, so background RGB is the closest faithful representation\n                    of the hidden spectrum available underneath a text character.\n                    """\n                    row_colors = (\n                        visualizer_rgb_rows[physical_row]\n                        if sample_background\n                        and 0 <= physical_row < len(visualizer_rgb_rows)\n                        else []\n                    )\n                    result:          continue\n\n                        character = styled_text[index]\n                        width = max(0, terminal_cell_width(character))\n                        if width <= 0:\n                            # Combining marks belong to the preceding glyph.\n                            result.append(character)\n                            index += 1\n                            continue\n\n                            index += 1\n                            continue\n\n                        if sample_background and row_colors:\n                            first = start_column + visible_cells * cell_multiplier\n                            last = first + max(1, width * cell_multiplier)\n                            samples = [\n                                color\n                                for column in range(first, min(last, len(row_colors)))\n                                if (color := row_colors[column]) is not None\n                            ]\n                            if samples:\n                                rgb = tuple(\n                                    round(\n                                        sum(color[channel] for color in samples)\n                                        / len(samples)\n                                    )\n                                    for channel in range(3)\n                                )\n _pillow_fit_canvas_image(data: bytes, width: int, height: int):\n            """Decode and contain one artwork blob in an exact transparent RGBA frame.\n\n            Crossfading sources of different shapes still requires identical frame\n            dimensions, but unused aspect-ratio gutters are alpha=0 so the popup\'s\n            chroma-key background shows the desktop rather than black letterboxing.\n            """\n            from PIL import Image, ImageOps  # type: ignore\n            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(data))) as opened:\n                source = opened.convert("RGBA").copy()\n            fitted = ImageOps.contain(\n                source,\n                (max(1, width), max(1, height)),\n                method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS,\n            )\n            canvas_image = Image.new("RGBA", (max(1, width), max(1, height)), (0, 0, 0, 0))\n            canvas_image.alpha_composite(\n                fitted,\n                ((canvas_image.width - fitted.width) // 2, (canvas_image.height - fitted.height) // 2),\n            )\n            return canvas_image, source\n\n        def _cancel_crossfade(*, commit_target: bool """Cheap per-glyph approximation of Pillow Color+Brightness transforms."""\n            red, green, blue = (float(value) for value in rgb)\n            gray = 0.299 * red + 0.587 * green + 0.114 * blue\n            sat = max(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MIN, min(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MAX, float(saturation)))\n            bright = max(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MIN, min(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MAX, float(brightness)))\n            values = (\n                (gray + (red - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (green - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (blue - gray) * sat) * bright,\n            )\n            return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(round(value)))) for value in values)  # type: ignore[return-value]\n\n        def _artwork_native_fast_path_allowed(\n            width: int, height: _pillow_fit_canvas_image(data: bytes, width: int, height: int):\n            """Decode and contain one artwork blob in an exact transparent RGBA frame.\n\n            Crossfading sources of different shapes still requires identical frame\n            dimensions, but unused aspect-ratio gutters are alpha=0 so the popup\'s\n            chroma-key background shows the desktop rather than black letterboxing.\n            """\n            from PIL import Image, ImageOps  # type: ignore\n            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(data))) as opened:\n                source = opened.convert("RGBA").copy()\n            fitted = ImageOps.contain(\n                source,\n                (max(1, width), max(1, height)),\n                method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS,\n            )\n            canvas_image = Image.new("RGBA", (max(1, width), max(1, height)), (0, 0, 0, 0))\n            canvas_image.alpha_composite(\n                fitted,\n                ((canvas_image.width - fitted.width) // 2, (canvas_image.height - fitted.height) // 2),\n            )\n            return canvas_image, source\n\n        def _cancel_crossfade(*, commit_target: bool """Cheap per-glyph approximation of Pillow Color+Brightness transforms."""\n            red, green, blue = (float(value) for value in rgb)\n            gray = 0.299 * red + 0.587 * green + 0.114 * blue\n            sat = max(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MIN, min(KARAOKE_SATURATION_MAX, float(saturation)))\n            bright = max(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MIN, min(KARAOKE_BRIGHTNESS_MAX, float(brightness)))\n            values = (\n                (gray + (red - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (green - gray) * sat) * bright,\n                (gray + (blue - gray) * sat) * bright,\n            )\n            return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(round(value)))) for value in values)  # type: ignore[return-value]\n\n        def _artwork_native_fast_path_allowed(\n            width: int, height:      def _pillow_char_is_emojiish(ch: str, next_ch: str = "") -> bool:\n            if not ch: return False\n            # U+26E4 is the same monochrome pentagram used by the console\n            # renderer.  It is in the broad dingbat range, but routing it to\n            # Segoe UI Emoji changes its metrics and can turn the outline into\n            # a colored/missing glyph in the floating bitmap.\n            if ch == "⛤":\n                return True\n            # Emojimaxx circled numbers are deliberate text symbols, not pictorial\n            # emoji.  Segoe UI Emoji renders U+2776 as a huge purple keycap-like\n            # disc, which destroys the fitted karaoke line and makes ❶ look like\n            # an unrelated icon. Keep the whole circled-number family in the\n            # primary lyric font.\n            if ch in CIRCLED_NUMBER_GLYPHS:\n                return False\n            cp=ord(ch); nxt=ord(next_ch) if next_ch else -1\n            return bool(0x1F000<=cp<=0x1FAFF or 0x1FC00<=cp<=0x1FFFF or 0x2600<=cp<=0x27FF or 0x2190<=cp<=0x21FF or 0x2300<=cp<=0x23FF or 0x2B00<=cp<=0x2BFF or 0x1F1E6<=cp<=0x1F1FF or 0x1F3FB<=cp<=0x1F3FF or cp in {0x00A9,0x00AE,0x2122,0x200D,0x20E3,0xFE0E,0xFE0F} or nxt in {0x20E3,0xFE0F})\n\n\n        @lru_cache(maxsize=8)\n        def _pillow_font_codepoints(path: str) -> frozenset(cp for table in face["cmap"].tables if table.isUnicode() for cp in table.cmap)\n                finally:\n                    face.close()\n            except Exception:\n                return frozenset()\n\n        @lru_cache(maxsize=256)\n        def _pillow_symbol_font(pixel_size: int):\n            from PIL import ImageFont  # type: ignore\n            path = preserving joined emoji clusters."""\n            for run, is_emoji in _pillow_mixed_font_runs(text):\n                if not is_emoji:\n                    yield run, False\n                    continue\n                preferred = emoji_font if emoji_font is not None else primary_font\n                coverage = _pillow_font_codepoints(str(getattr(preferred, "path", "")))\n     clusters = []\n                for ch in run:\n                    cp = ord(ch)\n                    if clusters and (cp in range(0xFE00, 0xFE10) or cp == 0x200D or 0x1F3FB <= cp <= 0x1F3FF or else:\n                        clusters.append(ch)\n                for cluster in clusters:\n                    yield cluster, True\n\n\n        def _pillow_run_advance(draw, run: str, font, *, is_emoji: bool) -> float:\n            """Return the visible horizontal advance for one mixed-font run.\n\n            Segoe UI Emoji\'s nominal advance can contain a conspicuous right-side\n            bearing.  When a colored emoji is followed by an ordinary source space,\n            that bearing plus the real space looks like two or three spaces.  Emoji\n            runs therefore advance to their *ink* right edge; ordinary text keeps\n            normal shaping/textlength semantics.  ``textbbox`` alone is not enough:\n            on some Windows color-font builds it still reports the glyph cell\'s\n            transparent right padding rather than its painted pixels.\n            """\n            kwargs={} if is_emoji else _pillow_cursive_shaping_kwargs()\n            if is_emoji:\n                # FreeType\'s rendered grayscale mask gives us the true ink bounds\n                # without depending on whether Pillow can composite this color\n                # emoji in the L-mode lyric mask.  Keep textbbox as the compatible\n                # fallback for older/non-FreeType emoji fonts.\n                try:\n                    glyph_mask = font.getmask(run, mode="L")\n                    ink_box = glyph_mask.getbbox()\n                    if ink_box is not None and int(ink_box[2]) > 0:\n                        return float(ink_box[2])\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n                try:\n                    box=draw.textbbox((0,0),run,font=font,anchor="ls")\n                    right=float(box[2])\n                    if math.isfinite(right) and right>0:\n                        return right\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n            try:\n                return max(0.0,float(draw.textlength(run,font=font,**kwargs)))\n            except Exception:\n                box=draw.textbbox((0,0),run,font=font,**kwargs)\n                return max(0.0,float(box[2]-box[0]))\n\n\n        def _pillow_mixed_text_width(draw, text: str, primary_font, emoji_font) -> float:\n            total=0.0\n            for run,is_emoji in _pillow_run_advance(draw,run,font,is_emoji=bool(is_emoji))\n            return total\n\n\n        def _pillow_font_metrics(font) -> tuple[int, int]:\n            """Return ascent/descent for cached fonts."""\n            from PIL import Image, ImageDraw  # type: ignore\n            scale = max(\n                EXTERNAL_ALBUM_ART_LYRIC_FONT_SCALE_MIN,\n                min(EXTERNAL_ALBUM_ART_LYRIC_FONT_SCALE_MAX, float(state.get("lyric_font_scale", 1.0) or 1.0)),\n            )\n            dpi = max(72, widget_dpi(root))\n            border = int(state.get("border_pixels", 5) or 5)\n            safe_x = max(12, border * 3)\n            safe_y = max(10, border * 2)\n            max_width = max(40, width - safe_x * 2)\n            max_height = max(24, height - safe_y * 2)\n            desired_points = max(12, min(260, round(min(width, height) * 0.085 * scale)))\n            desired_pixels = max(12, round(desired_points * dpi / 72.0))\n            scratch = Image.new("L", (8, 8), 0)\n            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(scratch)\n            words = lyric.split()\n\n            def candidate(pixel_size: int):\n                font = resolve_artwork_pillow_font(pixel_size)\n                emoji_font = resolve_artwork_pillow_emoji_font(pixel_size)\n\n                def measure(value: str) -> int:\n                    return max(0, int(round(_pillow_mixed_text_width(draw, value, font, emoji_font))))\n\n                lines: list[str] = []\n                current = ""\n                for word in words:\n                    proposed = word if not current else current + " " + word\n                    if current and measure(proposed) > max_width:\n                        lines.append(current)\n                        current = word\n                    else:\n                        current = proposed\n                if current:\n                    lines.append(current)\n                if not lines:\n                    lines = [lyric]\n                widths = [measure(line) for line in lines]\n                glyph_height = max(_pillow_mixed_line_metrics(font, emoji_font)[2] + 2, int(round(pixel_size * 1.22)))\n                distance_percent = max(SOLUTION_DISTANCE_MIN, min(SOLUTION_DISTANCE_MAX, int(state.get("artwork_solution_distance", SOLUTION_DISTANCE_DEFAULT))))\n                solution_extra = max(0, max(5, int(round(pixel_size * int(state.get("artwork_solution_size", 20)) / 100.0))) + int(round(pixel_size * distance_percent / 100.0)) + 4) if artwork_solutions_active() else 0\n                line_height = glyph_height + solution_extra\n                text_w = max(widths, default=1)\n                text_h = line_height * len(lines)\n                shadow = max(0, round(pixel_size * karaoke_shadow_size("artwork")))\n                padding = shadow + 4\n                if text_w + padding * 2 > max_width or text_h + padding * 2 > max_height:\n                    return None\n                return font, emoji_font, lines, widths, line_height, shadow, padding\n\n            # V372: a 4K window can produce a 300+ px desired font.  Walking\n            # every size downward repeatedly opened/measured fonts and was the\n            # largest cue-change spike.  Search for the largest fitting size in\n            # O(log N) candidates instead.\n            low, high = 10, desired_pixels\n            chosen = None\n            while low <= high:\n                mid = (low + high) // 2\n                attempt = candidate(mid)\n                if attempt is not None:\n                    chosen = attempt\n                    low = mid + 1\n                else:\n                    high = mid - 1\n            if chosen is None:\n                pixel_size = 10\n                font = resolve_artwork_pillow_font(pixel_size)\n                emoji_font = resolve_artwork_pillow_emoji_font(pixel_size)\n                lines = [lyric]\n                widths = [max(1, int(round(_pillow_mixed_text_width(draw, lyric, font, emoji_font))))]\n                chosen = (\n                    font,\n                    emoji_font,\n                    lines,\n                    widths,\n                    max(1, int(round(pixel_size * 1.22))),\n                    max(0, round(pixel_size * karaoke_shadow_size("artwork"))),\n                    5,\n                )\n            font, emoji_font, lines, widths, line_height, shadow, padding = chosen\n            state["artwork_plasma_line_step"] = line_height\n            state["artwork_plasma_glyph_height"] = max(_pillow_mixed_line_metrics(font, emoji_font)[2] + 2, int(round(getattr(font, "size", line_height) * 1.22)))\n            crop_w = max(1, max(widths, default=1) + padding * 2)\n            crop_h = max(1, line_height * len(lines) + padding * 2)\n            mask = Image.new("L", (crop_w, crop_h), 0)\n            mask_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)\n            colored = bool(state.get("popup_color_emoji_enabled", False))\n            overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (crop_w, crop_h), (0, 0, 0, 0)) if colored and emoji_font is not None else None\n            overlay_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay) if overlay is not None else None\n            for line_index, line in enumerate(lines):\n                x = (crop_w - No glyph is independently\n                    # redrawn, so cursive contextual joins/ligatures survive.\n                    gradient = Image.new("RGBA", (max(1, width), 1), (0, 0, 0, 0))\n                    gradient.putdata([\n                        (*_palette_rgb(PALETTE_STOPS[palette_index], ((x / max(1, width - 1)) + phase * 0.08) % 1.0), 255)\n                        for x in range(max(1, width))\n                    ])\n                    field = gradient.resize((max(1, width), max(1, height)), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)\n                    field.putalpha(mask)\n                else:\n                    # Legacy glyph coloring: resolve contiguous mask runs and\n                    # paint each run a uniform color. scales.\n                        horizontal_projection, _vertical_projection = mask.getprojection()\n                        active_columns = [bool(value) for value in horizontal_projection]\n                        runs = []\n                        start: int | None = None\n                        for x, active in enumerate(active_columns + [False]):\n                            if active and                start = None\n                        state["lyric_glyph_run_cache"] = (mask, runs)\n                    for glyph_index, (left, right) in enumerate(runs):\n                    field_draw.rectangle((left, 0, max(left, right - 1), height), fill=(*color, 255))\n                    field.putalpha(mask)\n            elif mode == "solid":\n
